title: Gift Wrap Roll

drivers.name: Price increase (3.4%)
drivers.evidence: Past promotions show no sustained lift; noise-adjusted estimate is x1.0. No evidence price changes drive demand here.

drivers.name: Supplier delivery warning
drivers.evidence: Single credible risk with no historical precedent. Shrink effect toward 1.0 due to low confidence. Supply constraints likely reduce available stock and lower demand.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 3.1. No events or promotions are scheduled. The price is up 3.4% (5.72 vs 5.53), which historically has not driven lift—past promotions show weak, noise-adjusted effects (x1.0). The week after a promotion typically sees a 16% drop (x0.84), but no recent promotion occurred. Supplier delivery warning introduces supply risk, likely reducing sell-in and lowering demand. This is a single, credible risk with no historical parallel, so we shrink the effect toward 1.0. The baseline already captures seasonal ramp (trend +34% over 13 weeks), so no additional seasonal adjustment. The uplift model’s x1.0 is consistent with weak past effects. We apply a modest downside adjustment for supply risk.

brief:
PRODUCT: Gift Wrap Roll | category Seasonal | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-06 (8 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: none
  shelf price: 5.72 (+3.4% vs regular price 5.53)
  planner notes: Supplier warns of a short delivery

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 3.1 | 5%-95%: 0.0 - 11.0 | 10%-90%: 0.0 - 9.4

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-95% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
